diagnosis: The required repair scope is stated in acceptance_conditions but has no corresponding content check. C7 incorrectly requires mentioning PVA rather than excluding ordinary PVA, so an unsafe repair can pass.
evidence: C7 permits any repair_scope containing 'wheat-starch paste', 'Japanese tissue', and 'PVA', while no check enforces reattaching the cover, resewing loose sections, or making a simple cloth spine.
